title: Tool catalog
description: Schema of shared/tool-catalog.json (the data file owned by the backend builder). The API serves these entries unchanged from GET /api/v1/tools, so the $defs below are identical to the same-named components.schemas in shared/openapi.yaml (a contract test enforces this). The endpoint of a tool is always POST /api/v1/{slug}. Slug uniqueness is not expressible in JSON Schema and is enforced by the CI catalog check.

schema_version.description: Catalog document format version. Bump only on a breaking change to this schema.

tools.description: Catalog entries in display order. The order is preserved by the API.

examples.title: Merge PDF
examples.description: Combine several PDF files into one document, in the order you choose.

seo.title: Merge PDF files online, without keeping them
seo.description: Combine PDF files into one in seconds. Your files are never stored: the result comes straight back in the response.

faq.question: Are my files stored after merging?
faq.answer: No. The file is processed in memory and the result is returned in the same request. Nothing is saved on our servers.

ToolCategory.description: Catalog grouping. Adding a category is a minor, additive change; clients must render unknown categories gracefully.

InputKind.description: Kind of input a tool accepts. file = multipart upload, url = web page address in a JSON body.

OutputKind.description: What a successful response carries. pdf, zip and txt are attachments; json is an inline JSON body.

ToolStatus.description: available = the endpoint exists and works. coming_soon = listed for SEO and roadmap; the endpoint does not exist yet (framework 404).

Tool.description: One tool in the catalog. Its endpoint is POST /api/v1/{slug}.

slug.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. It is both the URL path segment (POST /api/v1/{slug}) and the landing-page route (/tools/{slug}). Never reused for a different tool.

description.description: One-sentence summary for cards and listings.
examples: Combine several PDF files into one document, in the order you choose.

input_kinds.description: Kinds of input accepted. File tools are [file]; site comparison is [url].

accepts.description: MIME types accepted when input_kinds contains `file`. Informational for the UI file picker: the server decides by magic-byte sniffing and ignores the client Content-Type. Empty when no file input.

min_inputs.description: Minimum number of inputs (files or URLs) per request.

max_inputs.description: Maximum number of inputs per request. Exceeding it returns too_many_files.

options_schema.description: Name of the schema under components.schemas of shared/openapi.yaml that describes this tool's `options` object, or null when the tool takes no options.

phase.description: Delivery phase in which the tool becomes available. Informational (roadmap and coming-soon UI).

allOf.description: Catalog-data rule (not mirrored in OpenAPI): file tools must declare at least one accepted MIME type.

examples.description: Fetch two public web pages and see exactly what differs between them.

seo.title: Compare two web pages and see the differences
